captions.detailed: A precision roll-axis rotary module housed inside a dark gray, open-ended rectangular support frame. Inside the frame, a central light-gray cylindrical shaft is supported by two bearing cartridges mounted on the inner side walls. A small, dark-colored rectangular payload bracket is attached to the middle of the rotating shaft, allowing it to pivot coaxially about the central axis.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a precision roll-axis rotary module. The assembly should feature a rigid rectangular support frame, a central cylindrical shaft suspended between two bearing cartridges on the inner walls, and a compact payload bracket mounted on the shaft.
captions.factory: Construct the outer support frame using a hollowed-out box primitive. Inside the frame, instantiate two bearing blocks on opposite inner faces. Create a central shaft using a cylinder primitive aligned coaxially between the bearings, and mount a small rectangular payload bracket onto the midsection of the shaft.
